description: This file defines the Gamma class, which provides mathematical functions related to the gamma distribution, including gamma function calculation, distribution evaluation, inverse distribution, and logarithm of gamma function. It is part of a statistical calculation library within the PhpSpreadsheet project.

classes.name: Gamma
classes.description: Provides methods for computing gamma-related statistical functions such as the gamma function, gamma distribution, inverse gamma distribution, and the natural logarithm of the gamma function.

methods.name: gamma
methods.description: Calculates the gamma function value for a given input, handling arrays and individual values, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: distribution
methods.description: Computes the gamma distribution or its cumulative distribution function (CDF) or probability density function (PDF) based on parameters, with support for array inputs.

methods.name: inverse
methods.description: Calculates the inverse of the gamma distribution (quantile function) for a given probability, with validation and array support.

methods.name: ln
methods.description: Returns the natural logarithm of the gamma function at a given point, supporting array inputs and validation.
